card.name: Ends of amphetamine and pneumonia names
card.fires_on: The closing piece "phetamine" in amphetamine-type drug names (benzphetamine, d-amphetamine), and " pneumonia" inside pneumonia or bacterial names like Streptococcus pneumoniae.

modes.label: Amphetamine names
modes.description: The "phetamine" ending after "Benz" or "am" in stimulant drug names.

modes.label: Pneumonia in names
modes.description: The word " pneumonia" as a stem in disease or bacterial names, often followed by "e".
modes.example: such as Streptococcus<< pneumonia>>e, Neisseria meningitidis

card.plain: It fires near the end of the words amphetamine and pneumonia, including bacterial names like pneumoniae.
